data.title: Deep Source Appoints Lin Yujing as Non-Executive Director
data.description:
Theme International Holdings Limited ( (HK:0990) ) has shared an update.

Deep Source Holdings Limited announced the appointment of Lin Yujing as a non-executive director, effective November 20, 2026. Lin has more than 15 years of experience in corporate operations and market management, with recent experience focused on artificial intelligence computing infrastructure, data centre development and equipment supply chain management.

Since 2020, Lin has been deputy general manager of Xiamen Chuangpu Cloud Technology Co., Ltd., overseeing operations, project delivery and customer relationships, including GPU data centre development and equipment procurement. Her one-year appointment is subject to retirement by rotation and re-election, and includes a monthly director’s fee of HK$20,000 plus a discretionary bonus.

data.title: Leapmotor Enters EUR100 Million Opel C-SUV Cooperation Agreement
data.description:

data.title: Guotai Junan International Announces Up to HK$1,450,000,000 Revolving Facilities
data.description:
An update from Guotai Junan International Holdings Limited ( (HK:1788) ) is now available.

Guotai Junan International Holdings said on 20 November 2026 that it entered several committed facility agreements with certain Hong Kong banks in the ordinary course of business. The agreements provide committed revolving facilities totaling up to HK$1,450,000,000, with final repayment dates 12 months after the respective agreement dates.

The facilities require Guotai Haitong Securities Co., Ltd. to remain the Company’s single largest legal and beneficial shareholder and to continue controlling it. If that condition is not met, lenders may cancel commitments, declare loans, accrued interest and other amounts immediately due, or make loans payable on demand. Guotai Haitong was indirectly interested in approximately 73.92% of the Company’s shares as at 20 November 2026.

data.description:

data.title: Vitasoy Reports 8% Rise in Interim Attributable Profit
data.description:
Vitasoy International Holdings ( (HK:0345) ) has shared an update.

Vitasoy International Holdings offers soy and plant milk beverages and tofu, with businesses in the Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong SAR, Macau SAR, Australia, New Zealand and Singapore, as well as exports. Its Hong Kong operation has leadership in soy and plant milk beverages, while Singapore demand includes tofu and beverages.

Vitasoy reported revenue of HK$3.337 billion for the six months ended 30th September 2026, up 3% year on year, while gross profit margin rose to 51.9% and profit attributable to equity shareholders increased 8% to HK$184.755 million. Revenue growth was supported by foreign-exchange translation; lower commodity costs and manufacturing efficiency helped margin, partly offset by higher trade promotional expenses.

Chinese Mainland revenue declined slightly in local currency but retained a double-digit operating profit margin; Hong Kong performance was supported by soy and plant milk leadership, partly offset by weaker Macau demand, while Australia and New Zealand recorded lower Australian-dollar sales and a higher operating loss. Singapore revenue grew on demand for tofu and beverages. The group repurchased 5,602,000 shares for approximately HK$36 million and declared an interim dividend of HK4.0 cents per share.
